title: Unified Inference: Product Overview, PRD, Roadmap & Pricing (Oct 2026 Release)
author: Ava Patel
content:
Overview
========
Short intro: This document describes the Unified Inference product surface for the Oct 2026 release: product goals, high-level PRD and requirements, design notes, roadmap and themes for Q4 2026 - Q1 2027, pricing and packaging changes, and release notes including rollout and post-release metrics. It is intended for product, engineering, sales enablement, and customer-success stakeholders.

Goals (TL;DR)
---------------
- Deliver a single, unified inference API and console experience across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
- Reduce average per-token cost by 18% for common workloads via batching, caching and quantization recommendations.
- Provide clear pricing and packaging to accelerate self-serve adoption and enterprise contract conversion.
- Ship rollout automation (canary + A/B) and rollback controls in Console.

Background and context
-----------------------
Redwood's Unified Inference initiative combines runtime improvements and product-level controls to make serving predictable across different deployment modes. Customers have requested: (1) simpler pricing that maps to their unit economics, (2) bundled recommendations that reduce ops lift, and (3) safer rollout primitives for model and route changes. This release consolidates work from runtime, optimize, and console teams.

Success metrics (North Star & OKRs)
----------------------------------
- Activation: 20% uplift in self-serve projects using Dedicated trial within 60 days.
- Cost savings: mean per-token cost reduction >= 18% for customers opted into Optimize recommendations.
- Reliability: P95 request latency within target SLOs for 95% of production routes.
- Conversion: 12% increase in leads converting to reserved capacity contracts within 90 days.

Product requirements (PRD)
--------------------------
1) Unified API parity
   - Requirement: Single REST/SDK surface for text generation, chat, embeddings, and reranking with backward-compatible endpoints.
   - Acceptance criteria: Existing client SDKs (Python, Typescript) pass the integration test-suite with <1% behavior drift.

2) Cost controls and Optimize integration
   - Requirement: Expose Optimize recommendations in Console per route (batching, cache TTL, quantization profile).
   - Acceptance criteria: Console shows recommendation + estimated monthly $ impact. API exposes a new header x-redwood-optimize-applied: true when a recommendation is active.

3) Rollouts & fallback policies
   - Requirement: Canary and A/B rollout flows in Console with automatic fallback to pinned model when error rate > 1.5% or latency breach.
   - Acceptance criteria: Canary rollouts can be scheduled and automated through API; fallback executed correctly in simulated outage tests.

4) Pricing & packaging clarity
   - Requirement: Publish clear pricing tiers (Self-serve Hosted, Dedicated reserved, Private enterprise) including per-token, per-embedding, and reserved capacity credits.
   - Acceptance criteria: Pricing page updated; Sales and Billing have mapping doc linking SDK usage -> invoice line items.

Design spec highlights
----------------------
- API: single /v1/inference endpoint with parameterized mode: {"mode":"chat|generate|embed|rerank"}. Deprecated endpoints are supported with server-side redirects for 6 months.
- Console UX: per-route recommendation panel, rollout control with live canary % slider, and rollout health badges (green/yellow/red).
- Optimize integration: recommendations are generated offline by Optimize service and surfaced via an internal feature flag. Each recommendation includes rationale, expected cost delta, and risk score.
- Telemetry: new rollout events (rollout.started, rollout.updated, rollout.rolled_back) emitted to observability pipeline with route_id, model_variant, %_traffic, and health_metrics.

Non-functional requirements
---------------------------
- SLOs: 99.9% availability for Hosted endpoints, P95 latency targets per model class (see table below).
- Security: Traffic between Console and private deployments must use mutual TLS; KMS-integrations for Private must be auditable.
- Scalability: Service must support 3x current peak qps during sale-driven spikes with autoscaling.

Latency SLOs table
--------------------
| Model class | P95 latency (ms) | Target availability | Notes |
| small (seq<=512) | 120 ms | 99.9% | optimized kernels |
| medium (seq<=1024) | 220 ms | 99.9% | batching recommended |
| large (seq>1024) | 600 ms | 99.5% | recommend quantized variants |

Roadmap & themes (Q4 2026 - Q1 2027)
-------------------------------------
- Theme 1 (Oct 2026): Unified API + Console rollout controls - core feature set for GA.
- Theme 2 (Nov-Dec 2026): Optimize integration surface and per-route cost recommendations.
- Theme 3 (Jan 2027): Pricing and packaging updates + Dedicated trial expansion.
- Theme 4 (Feb-Mar 2027): Private deployment hardening and enterprise compliance packaging.

Milestones and timeline
1. 2026-10-01: Draft PRD complete (this doc).
2. 2026-10-10: API contract review and SDK compatibility tests.
3. 2026-10-20: Console canary controls merged and e2e tests green.
4. 2026-11-05: Public pricing page and sales enablement updated.
5. 2026-11-15: GA release for Unified Inference (Hosted + Console features).
6. 2026-12-15: Optimize recommendations FT release.
7. 2027-01-15: Dedicated trial expansion.

Pricing & packaging notes
-------------------------
Summary of changes:
- Hosted (self-serve): introduce three usage tiers (Starter, Growth, Scale) with volume discounts at 1M token and 10M token thresholds. Pricing expresses effective cost-per-1k tokens for generate/chat and per-embedding unit for embeddings.
- Dedicated: reserved capacity credits now include burst credits (10%) for short spikes; contracts include SLA @ 99.95% availability.
- Private: enterprise licensing updates include optional compliance add-ons (SOC2+PCI evidence package, enhanced audit retention).

Example pricing table (excerpt)
| Tier | Generate (per 1k tokens) | Embeddings (per 1k units) | Notes |
| Starter | $0.016 | $0.012 | up to 1M tokens/mo |
| Growth | $0.012 | $0.009 | 1M-10M tokens/mo |
| Scale | $0.008 | $0.007 | >10M tokens/mo, committed |

Packaging guidance for Sales
- For customers with predictable throughput > 100 QPS, recommend Dedicated with a 6-12 month reserved contract.
- Offer a 60-day Dedicated trial for qualified customers (see trial-eligibility checklist).
- For regulated customers, lead with Private + Compliance Add-on. Provide pricing worksheet mapping committed spend -> reserved GPU capacity.

Release notes (GA: 2026-11-15)
------------------------------
Summary: GA release of Unified Inference which includes:
- Unified /v1/inference API with backward compatibility shims.
- Console rollout controls: canary scheduling, A/B testing, and automatic fallback.
- Optimize recommendations surfaced in Console (beta).
- Pricing page updated with tiered self-serve pricing and Dedicated burst credits.

Notable fixes and changes
- Fixed: token accounting mismatch causing inflated embedding bills under extreme batch sizes (billing patch deployed 2026-10-12).
- Changed: deprecated /v0/chat endpoint will be removed after 2027-05-01; deprecation notice added to SDKs.
- Known limitation: Private on-prem installers require kernel-level GPU drivers v525+. Installation docs updated under eng-private-deployments/reference-architectures.

Rollout plan & risk mitigation
-------------------------------
1. Internal canary (2026-10-25): 5% internal traffic, validate telemetry and billing.
2. External limited GA (2026-11-01): opt-in customers + selected partners.
3. Full GA (2026-11-15): public availability.
4. Post-release monitoring: 14-day intensive watch with SRE and product oncall rotation; automated health alerts for increased error rates, latency regression, and billing anomalies.

Post-release evaluation checklist (30/60/90 days)
------------------------------------------------
- 30 days: Verify activation KPIs and early adopter feedback; fix top 5 customer-reported issues.
- 60 days: Evaluate cost savings realized by customers using Optimize recommendations; iterate UI.
- 90 days: Measure conversion to Dedicated reserved contracts and publish case studies.

Appendix A - API contract example (curl)
--------------------------------------
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/inference \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"mode":"chat","model":"rw-unified-v2","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain batch sizing"}],"route":"default"}'

Appendix B - Checklist: Dedicated trial eligibility
---------------------------------------------------
1) Company size > 50 engineers or monthly tokens > 2M OR clear latency-critical production workload.
2) Has legal/compliance readiness for DSAs and MSAs.
3) Assigned technical contact for onboarding (solutions engineer).
